title: Bishops of the same color
line: Put your pawns on the other color from your bishop.

steps.text: Both bishops run on light squares. A pawn on a light square can be attacked by the enemy bishop. One on a dark square cannot.
Tap every white pawn on a light square.
steps.hint: The same color as the square your bishop stands on.
steps.after: All three can be attacked by Black's bishop. Black's pawns all stand on dark squares.

steps.text: You have Black. Your bishop attacks a white pawn that nothing guards. Take it.
steps.hint: The pawn stands two squares from your bishop, on one of its diagonals.
steps.after: The pawn on the light square fell. Black's pawns on dark squares are out of reach.

steps.text: Now you have White, in the same position. Guard the pawn the bishop attacks.

wrong.f1g2: That guards it too, but Black's bishop turns to the pawn on a4, and it falls.

steps.hint: Move the bishop one square along its diagonal toward the middle.
steps.after: The pawn is guarded, but it stays a target. Pawns belong on the other color from your bishop.

summary: When the bishops run on the same color, put your pawns on the other color, and attack the enemy pawns on yours.
